== Lead photograph and Decipher employment ==
* Lead: [[:File:Marcus Sheppard DecipherCon 1999 portrait.jpg]], a centered head-and-shoulders crop (230×215) of sun16; head center within 1px of the crop center. The uncropped original stays in Photographs. No other captioned photograph of him turned up on [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]] or in 27 DecipherCon 2000 and 2002 photo pages read so far (of 139).
* Employment: Decipher bylines and captions call him "Decipher's Euro Marketing crew" (1999), "Decipher Inc. European Marketing Team" (2001) and "European Marketing Representative, Decipher Inc." (2002). His 2000 DecipherCon reports are signed "DecipherCon 2000 Guest Writer"; that year alone is billed as a contributing writer.
